label: Aqara Smart Video Doorbell G4
description: Aqara Smart Video Doorbell G4 is a 1080p battery-or-wired doorbell camera with on-device face recognition, HomeKit Secure Video and a local chime repeater. Its only network interface is 2.4 GHz 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi (1T1R), and it can also repeat Wi-Fi for nearby Aqara devices; there is no Ethernet port, and the USB-C socket is a 5 V/1 A power input rather than a data link.
